evals.prompt: Create an AGENTS.md for this project.
evals.expected_output: Detection is run; commands come from package.json scripts (build, test, test:e2e, lint, typecheck) and the install command from the lockfile; ESLint and Vitest are named from their configs; ARCHITECTURE.md is linked, not pasted; the audit passes; nothing is invented.
assertions: Every command in the Commands table exists in package.json scripts or derives from the lockfile
ESLint and Vitest are mentioned because their config files exist, and no other tool is invented
ARCHITECTURE.md is referenced by path and its content is not copied
The audit script reports ok: true
No section is left empty or with template placeholders

evals.prompt: Update our AGENTS.md and make it tool-neutral; we have an INSTRUCTIONS.md from an old setup.
evals.expected_output: The conventions in INSTRUCTIONS.md (run size before finishing, never break hard rules, reply in Portuguese) are listed and the user is asked which to carry over and what to do with the file; INSTRUCTIONS.md is not deleted or renamed; the workbench section is byte-identical; the false command `bun run tests` and the missing `docs/ARCH.md` are corrected and listed in the report.
assertions: The user is asked, with a recommendation, which INSTRUCTIONS.md conventions to carry over before they are written
INSTRUCTIONS.md still exists, unrenamed, after the skill runs
The workbench section is reported as unchanged by the audit
`bun run tests` is replaced by an existing script and the change is listed in the report
The reference to docs/ARCH.md is fixed or removed and listed in the report

evals.prompt: Audit AGENTS.md, we changed the test runner last week.
evals.expected_output: Only the audit path runs; unknown commands and missing paths are reported; fixes are grounded in the current package.json scripts; no other section is rewritten.
assertions: The audit script is run before any edit
Only commands and paths flagged by the audit are changed
Sections not affected by the audit are byte-identical
The report lists each change with the script it now points to
